nodes.description: Public constant state variable 'name' of ConnectAuth set to "Auth-v1".
Internal pure helper of Basics returning the hardcoded InstaEvent address 0x2af7ea6Cb911035f3eb1ED895Cb6692C39ecbA97.
Public pure connector identifier returning (_type=1, _id=10).
External payable function that enables an authority address on this contract and emits auth events, without any access-control check.
External payable function that disables an authority address on this contract and emits auth events, without any access-control check.
msg.sender, the untrusted caller used both as the subject of the auth events and as the caller that can freely invoke add()/remove().
External call AccountInterface(address(this)).enable(authority) performed by add().
External call AccountInterface(address(this)).disable(authority) performed by remove().
External call EventInterface(getEventAddr()).emitEvent(_type,_id,_eventCode,_eventParam) forwarding auth data to the InstaEvent contract.
Parameter 'authority' of add(address authority).
Parameter 'authority' of remove(address authority).
Local bytes32 _eventCode = keccak256("LogAddAuth(address,address)") in add().
Local bytes _eventParam = abi.encode(msg.sender, authority) in add().
Local uint _type returned by connectorID() inside add().
Local uint _id returned by connectorID() inside add().
Local bytes32 _eventCode = keccak256("LogRemoveAuth(address,address)") in remove().
Local bytes _eventParam = abi.encode(msg.sender, authority) in remove().
Local uint _type returned by connectorID() inside remove().
Local uint _id returned by connectorID() inside remove().
Returned uint _type of connectorID() set to 1.
Returned uint _id of connectorID() set to 10.

edges.reason: add() is externally callable by any msg.sender and unconditionally invokes AccountInterface(address(this)).enable(authority) with no owner/authority check.
add() forwards the auth event to the external InstaEvent contract via emitEvent().
remove() is externally callable by any msg.sender and unconditionally invokes AccountInterface(address(this)).disable(authority) with no owner/authority check.
remove() forwards the auth event to the external InstaEvent contract via emitEvent().
The untrusted caller msg.sender reaches the authority-enabling external call because add() lacks any restriction on who may grant authorities.
msg.sender is abi.encoded and passed as event data to emitEvent().
The authority parameter is passed directly into the external enable() call.
The authority parameter is passed directly into the external disable() call.
add() computes the local event code hash _eventCode.
The event code hash is forwarded as an argument of emitEvent().
The encoded event payload is forwarded as an argument of emitEvent().
msg.sender is encoded into the _eventParam of add().
The authority parameter is encoded into the _eventParam of add().
Connector type _type is forwarded as an argument of emitEvent().
Connector id _id is forwarded as an argument of emitEvent().
connectorID() returns the connector type consumed by add().
connectorID() returns the connector id consumed by add().
remove() computes the local event code hash _eventCode.
The removal event code hash is forwarded as an argument of emitEvent().
The encoded removal payload is forwarded as an argument of emitEvent().
msg.sender is encoded into the _eventParam of remove().
The authority parameter is encoded into the _eventParam of remove().
Connector type _type from remove() is forwarded as an argument of emitEvent().
Connector id _id from remove() is forwarded as an argument of emitEvent().
connectorID() returns the connector type consumed by remove().
connectorID() returns the connector id consumed by remove().
getEventAddr() supplies the EventInterface target address used for the emitEvent() external call.
connectorID() assigns its returned type value 1 to _type.
connectorID() assigns its returned id value 10 to _id.
The external enable() call into address(this) can re-enter add() before the surrounding logic and event emission complete.
The external disable() call into address(this) can re-enter remove() before the surrounding logic and event emission complete.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter authority only exists inside add() and is consumed by its enable()/emitEvent() calls, so it folds into the add function node.
Parameter authority only exists inside remove() and is consumed by its disable()/emitEvent() calls, so it folds into the remove function node.
Local event code hash is created and used solely within add().
Local encoded payload is created and used solely within add().
Local connector type variable is scoped to add().
Local connector id variable is scoped to add().
Local event code hash is created and used solely within remove().
Local encoded payload is created and used solely within remove().
Local connector type variable is scoped to remove().
Local connector id variable is scoped to remove().
Returned type value is produced only by the connectorID() function body.
Returned id value is produced only by the connectorID() function body.
